The proposal came back with no issues.

The field only exists so far. Nothing fills it in yet, and I didn't change any action, such as `deploy` or `record_deployment`, to do that. Filling the field will need a follow-up change. Either the kernel's deployment reply carries the replaced commit, or a link to the environment is added.

I didn't read the other domain, because the request only concerns delivery requests.
